verified_sources.source_name: Jotun Middle East - Jotashield Exterior Fence & Masonry Protection
verified_sources.key_insights: Capillary action of irrigation water on boundary masonry. Dual-action silane-siloxane impregnators for garden curbs, 100% pure acrylic elastomeric coatings, and salt efflorescence barrier primers.

The 'Irrigation Sprinkler Failure Cycle' (حلقة تلف رشاشات الري): Brackish water (ماء صليبي) used for landscaping contains high TDS (Total Dissolved Solids >1500 ppm). Continuous sprinkler spray against boundary walls forces salts into plaster, causing explosive delamination of surface paint within 6 months.

verified_sources.source_name: Kuwait Exterior Villa Renovation Field Ledger 2026
verified_sources.key_insights: Remediation methodology: Mechanical scraping of decayed bottom meter -> Crystalline damp-proof barrier -> Cementitious waterproof putty -> Heavy exterior masonry coating (Sigma or Elastomeric). Cost per linear meter (4.500 to 7.500 KWD turnkey).
